analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($328.45) vs SMA5/20/50($339.35/$345.82/$352.59): Below short-term and mid-term moving averages, indicating a weak position.
· Below SMA100/200($370.19/$366.65): Maintaining bearish strength in the mid-to-long term trend.
· 52-week position (18.8%) + Current price above 52-week low($289.96), approaching historical low levels.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (34.3→41.7): Confirmed exit from oversold territory, suggesting upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-2.9992→0.3606): Entering weak convergence, potential for trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $313.82): Approaching the lower band, with band width (18.51%) expanding.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($324.50): Above Pivot S1($305.51), close to the 5-day low($323.25).
· Swing resistance ($339.99): Close to SMA5($339.35), potential for short-term bounce strengthening on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: 5-day low($323.25) > 20-day low($320.23) shows insufficient Higher Low confirmation, entering a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.35x): Subdued compared to the 5-day average, reducing confidence in the price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: Attempting a bounce within a downtrend, prioritizing RSI and CCI bounce signals for buy consideration.
